'''Hydro-dispensers''' were devices that squirted hydration fluids into hands. The [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Varko (Selkath)|Varko]] had to use them while [[Gender/Legends|he]] got used to being above [[Water/Legends|water]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].
